title: A parcel against the clock
description: A parcel travels from a small shop, through a sorting centre, to your door before its two-day deadline runs out.

atRest.caption: Press Play to follow a parcel from the shop to your door.

intro.caption: The shop promises delivery within 48 hours, so it winds a stopwatch.
The clock starts the moment the parcel leaves the shop.

moments.caption: A courier picks up the parcel from the shop.
At the sorting centre, the parcel waits in line behind three others.
At the front, a scanner reads the label and picks the right van.
The van drives the parcel to the receiver's town.
Delivered with 8 hours to spare. The promise is kept.
